shapes.rule: A power channel is an INTERVAL_MEAN over [t, t + step) with interval_end = source time = t + step and the block value at t; generator status and state-of-charge stay STATE_AT_INSTANT points at t.

verify.source: MD-0b: SYSTEM VERIFY freeze, later-selection bind and evaluation through the Action API (tools/demo_combined_kobo.py _trial_chain). Baseline = the overrun hour. The freeze waits until the baseline's UTC days are final (a UTC day's dispatch run reads to 06:00Z of the next UTC day, so it is re-selected until then: BASELINE_SELECTION_CHANGED, B/actions/verification.py _assess) and precedes any later-window reading (VERIFICATION_LATER_WINDOW_STARTED, freeze check); the later window is the same UTC clock hour two days on; bind and evaluate once the later window and its UTC days to 06:00Z are delivered
